chapter: Trummy Young's band, 52nd Street and the Navy
title: The telegram from Billy Eckstine
summary: Eckstine wires asking him and Tommy Potter to join a new band in New York, and Malachi replies he is on his way.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Anyway, I came on out. After I was home about a week, a couple of weeks... I don't even know how the news got to New York, but I got this telegram that I still have now, that said

"Forming a band. Would like to have you and Tommy Potter come to New York and join the band." I have it here. Sometime I'll show it to you. But it said, "Regards, Billy Eckstine." Right away, I sent him one back, and said "I'm on my way." So this began another phase that we'll go into and talk about later!
